text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The PlayStation 4 was released in 2013 as Sony's eighth-generation home console. It focused on digital distribution, online services, and social features while using PC-based hardware architecture. The system supported Blu-ray discs, downloadable games, streaming applications, and PlayStation VR. Its library included games such as Bloodborne, Horizon Zero Dawn, God of War, Spider-Man, and The Last of Us Part II. The PlayStation 4 became one of Sony's most successful consoles and remained supported alongside the PlayStation 5.
